svg.title: Scalus JIT compile time against UPLC term size, before and after the fix
svg.desc: 89 contracts. Before the fix: median 21.9 s over the 80 that compiled within the 120 s timeout; 9 finished after it, in 135 to 197 s. After the fix: median 2.3 s, maximum 7.6 s.
svg.text: Scalus JIT: compile time of 89 contracts
One dot per contract, fresh staging compiler per script, Apple M3 Max, October 2026
